# agents v0.8.1 — the shipped text stops pointing at deleted files

A patch release. No command changed shape and no exit code moved. What changed is
the text this release carries: two embedded assets, and the `README.md` that
travels in the archive beside the binary.

Two of the three carried the same defect: each sent its reader to a document in
the dotfiles repository that had been deleted, so each shipped a citation to a file
that does not exist — the defect class this project removes, still live in the
artifact that distributes it. The third was missing the status rule the store
itself follows.

## What changed

**The bundled skill no longer cites a deleted design.** `init` installs
`recording-what-you-learn`, and its closing section told the reader to consult
`docs/design/2026-08-19-knowledge-is-documentation.md`. That document was deleted
on 2026-10-12, along with the system it described, so every repository initialized
from v0.8.0 received a pointer to nothing. The section now says the evidence was in
a design since deleted, and that its last revision is in git history.

**The archive's README no longer cites a deleted analysis.** `agents/README.md` is
copied into the release archive, and it sent the reader to
`docs/design/2026-10-09-the-personal-build-removal-analysis.md`, deleted the same
day. It now states the decision instead of citing it: the checkout build is gone,
and `go build -o /tmp/agents .` is the inner loop that replaced it.

**The plans template carries the status rule.** `init` writes
`docs/plans/README.md` from an embedded template, and the template did not have the
rule the store itself follows: **every plan opens with a `Status:` line.** Without
one, a plan whose work finished years ago and a plan someone is about to execute
read the same, and the plans store is where a reader goes for what to do next. New
repositories get the rule now.

## Upgrading

```
brew upgrade agents
```

Nothing to convert. The chain record, the hooks path and `doctor`'s checks are
unchanged from v0.8.0, and this release changes no command's arguments, output
shape or exit codes.

An existing repository keeps the files it already has. `init` writes a store's
README and a skill only when the path is absent, so this release rewrites nothing
you have customized. To adopt any of this text in an existing repository, copy it
from `agents/internal/scaffold/assets/` or `agents/README.md` in the dotfiles
repository.

## Checks

`agents` 10 packages (8 with tests) and `bootstrap.d` 6, whole runs; the documents
guards; and the CI gate on Debian and Arch (stage zero included), macOS, and the
hygiene legs.
